claims: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket carried the Orion spacecraft.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
The Artemis II launch site is NASA's Kennedy Space Center, specifically Launch Pad 39B.
The Artemis II launch location is Cape Canaveral, Florida.
The rocket for the Artemis II mission is the Space Launch System (SLS).
Artemis II is the first crewed Artemis mission.
Artemis I launched from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B in November 2022.
